feeds.title: ICTEvangelist Blog
feeds.description: Award-winning blogger, author, & speaker Mark Anderson combines his knowledge of technology & teaching to share his passion for learning & tech innovation. Drawing on his experience as an assistant headteacher, Mark uses his blog to give classroom advice for educators, app ideas to encourage learning, and personal anecdotes.

feeds.title: The Ed Techie Blog
feeds.description: The Ed Techie is Martin Weller's blog on open education, digital scholarship & over-stretched metaphors. Martin is a Professor of Educational Technology at the Open University. He has been at the OU since 1995 and chaired their first major online course in 1999. If interested you can watch his inaugural lecture which reviews much of his OU history. His interests are in Digital Scholarship, educational technology, open education and impact of new technologies.

feeds.title: FE News » EdTech
feeds.description: Discover EdTech articles on FE News relating to education technology, chatbots, AI, cybersecurity, hybrid learning, cloud technology, TEL, machine learning, big data, blockchain, eLearning, DCMS and more! FE News is the largest online news site and digital publishing platform dedicated solely for the further education, apprenticeship / work-based learning and employability sector. We have been around for nearly 20 years.

feeds.title: UK Education Blog » Ed Tech
feeds.description: The UK Education Blog provides information about general education matters in the UK, including Education News & Insights freshly delivered covering EdTech, ELearning, Learning Apps, Video Gaming, Online Teaching & Learning, Tutoring and more! Browse through our EdTech articles for more information on resources available, tips for incorporating EdTech in the classroom and more!

feeds.title: EdTechist
feeds.description: Get the latest information, Insights from the Edtech sector and read well-researched, compelling, and empowering, articles on the advent of Education technology in children's lives. EdTechist is a blog by Michael Johnston. As a Teacher, Subject Leader, Author, and Podcaster, He regularly writes about EdTech and developed CPD courses for teachers.

feeds.title: School Jotter Blog
feeds.description: Here you will find a great collection of education technology articles, school website software ideas, and best practice resources. Since 2003, we've been working with thousands of schools across the UK and worldwide to develop the best school websites and online educational software. School Jotter is now the UK's most popular school website platform, and can be found in thousands of schools globally. It is a complete school web design, hosting and content management system (CMS) with an intuitive and easy-to-use interface.

feeds.title: Jameskieft Blog
feeds.description: I am James Kieft. I review a range of ed-tech sites and apps along with sharing my approaches to using technology in the classroom. I am passionate about how technology can be used to benefit teaching learning and assessment. I have a wealth of teaching experience with over 25 years of teaching across Further and Higher education. I am passionate about teaching and learning and how technology can be used to enhance it.

feeds.title: The Whiteboard Blog
feeds.description: An educational blog that looks at the use of technology in the classroom - mainly Interactive Whiteboards or resources that work well on them. Also, find CPD for interactive whiteboards and other educational technology including iPads, & Android Tablets. Written by Danny Nicholson.

feeds.title: Technology for Learners » Education
feeds.description: Designed for anyone & everyone, Technology for Learners provides guidance on how to get the most out of technology - to help improve your learning, teaching or business performance. Our education section features the growing use of technology in education, insights, news, tips and more!

feeds.title: Al Kingsley Blog
feeds.description: Al Kingsley's EdTech Blog covers articles on all sorts of topics from EdTech to DigCit, SEMH, Digital Poverty, Education and more! Al Kingsley has over 30 years' experience in the technology sector predominantly with his work on IT Asset Management, educational and Instructional technology and digital safeguarding.

feeds.title: LearnJam Blog
feeds.description: We help you achieve your organizational purpose and goals through learning experiences that are engaging, effective and inclusive. Our collective expertise combines learning design, teaching, publishing, ed-tech, management consultancy and educational systems change. Browse through our research and insights in ed-tech in our blog.

feeds.title: Round Midnight
feeds.description: Find the latest news on a variety of topics relating to virtual reality, education, tech for good knife crime, and social impact subjects. Round Midnight is a Multi-award winning Birmingham-based Creative Arts company specializing in drama and tech in education.

feeds.title: Uni of Nottingham Blog
feeds.description: Uni of Nottingham features news, information, advice and tips about Moodle, Turnitin, ExamSys, Xerte Online Toolkits and other core University learning technologies. We also cover digital pedagogy, online learning, design and planning and an eclectic selection of web-based resources, videos and events of use to learners and teachers. Check out their insights on educational technology, advantages, reports and more!

feeds.title: ResourcEd
feeds.description: ResourcEd keeps teachers across the UK ahead of the curve. Deliver teaching experiences that meet the needs of modern learners. Find the latest teaching tools and teacher resources; navigate through our blogs, infographics, videos, and guides.

feeds.title: Tech Trends » EdTech
feeds.description: EdTech Trends is a showcase of all the latest Education Technology news, articles and reviews from technology author and journalist Alice Bonasio.

feeds.title: EdTech Hub Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with the latest insights, trends, and news from EdTech Hub and our partners. EdTech Hub is a global research partnership. Our goal is to empower people by giving them the evidence they need to make decisions about technology in education.
